event.description:
Curious about Grand Archive TCG? Join us at Dragon's Gate Gaming for a FREE Learn to Play & Casual Play night!

Completely new? No worries! We have store demo decks and Pantheon decks available to borrow, so you don't need to bring anything.

Learn the basics, try different decks, meet other players and enjoy friendly games in a welcoming environment.

Already play? Bring your deck and help us grow Brisbane's Grand Archive community!

All experience levels welcome!
event.name: Learn to Play & Casual Play
